task_description: Pivot EchoGuard from Wi-Fi CSI fall detection to a sitting/standing time tracker web app: finish the timed hands-free room calibration (leave the room, 5 s grace to come back, walk, stand still, sit, with total time), build a per-room sitting-vs-standing posture model from calibration, track sitting/standing/moving time, sitting streaks, stand reminders and stand hours, persist live history locally, export for health providers, and ship a minimal dashboard website (no gradients, system font) with health information.
